integrity: An explicit Euler-trail proof and reproducible stdlib finite checks accompany the generating function. Finite tests do not certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only complete error-free linear adjacent-pair multiplicity profiles for a three-letter alphabet are enumerated; not cyclic profiles, longer reads, noisy profiles, or class cardinalities. The 2012 expanded IEEE paper was accessible only at abstract level; earlier implicit equivalent statements remain possible.
title: Exact ternary adjacent-pair profile generating function
